mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, agent_id, checkpoint_seq, provider, provider_session_id, runtime_id, executor_id, active_step_id, oss_ref, sha256, size_bytes, completion_result_id, gc_pending, gmt_create
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch_recovery_checkpoint (tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, agent_id, checkpoint_seq, provider, provider_session_id, runtime_id, executor_id, active_step_id, oss_ref, sha256, size_bytes, completion_result_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{dispatchId}, #{agentId}, #{checkpointSeq}, #{provider}, #{providerSessionId}, #{runtimeId}, #{executorId}, #{activeStepId}, #{ossRef}, #{sha256}, #{sizeBytes}, #{completionResultId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE gc_pending = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} ORDER BY checkpoint_seq DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: (c.completion_result_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_result_decision r WHERE r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND r.result_id=c.completion_result_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.id=c.dispatch_id AND (d.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','TIMEOUT','CANCELED') OR NOT (d.executor_id <=> c.executor_id))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_recovery r WHERE r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND r.cancel_requested=1))
mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id,c.dispatch_id FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint c WHERE c.gc_pending=0 AND AND (c.completion_result_id IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint n WHERE n.gc_pending=0 AND n.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND n.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND (n.checkpoint_seq>c.checkpoint_seq OR (n.checkpoint_seq=c.checkpoint_seq AND n.id>c.id))) >= #{retain}) GROUP BY c.tenant_id,c.dispatch_id ORDER BY MIN(c.id) LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dispatch_recovery_checkpoint SET gc_pending=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND id=#{id} AND gc_pending=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE gc_pending=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE gc_pending=1 AND id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND id = #{id}
